stories.title: Three accounts, every component agreeing
One account in two cost centres; the TB swaps their movements
stories.recipe: The two centres together agree; each one alone does not.

stories.title: The same net with another turnover
stories.recipe: Both nets are 5,000.00; the GL turned over 9,000 and 4,000, the TB 7,000 and 2,000.

stories.title: A written zero, and a blank amount
stories.recipe: A written zero is an amount; a blank period credit is not.

stories.title: An opening and a closing with no movement between them
stories.recipe: The GL section cannot explain its own closing.

stories.title: A movement posted after the period end
A TB page with August in its header
Sub-accounts and their parent total
stories.recipe: The total is checked and never compared with the GL.

stories.title: A parent total that disagrees with its rows
stories.recipe: Each row agrees with the GL; the total says a row is missing or extra.

stories.title: A second snapshot of one account on another page
stories.recipe: Two equal snapshots are still two.

stories.title: An account code that lost its leading zero
A section without its dimensions label
stories.recipe: The section after cc=31 does not inherit it; every 2200 waits.

stories.title: A zero account in the TB with no GL section
A GL section from August
Two GL sections for one account
A note written between two sections
stories.recipe: Nothing says which section the note belongs to.

stories.title: Kuwaiti dinars, Arabic-Indic digits, Arabic dimensions
stories.recipe: Three decimals: the TB credits 1.010 where the GL credits 1.005.

stories.title: A TB row whose own bridge breaks
A section left without its end row
A section without its opening row
A TB page that never ends
stories.recipe: Rows after an unclosed page could belong to any page.

stories.title: A section whose account reads as a formula
Totals: one over nothing, one with a blank
stories.recipe: A total that cannot be read cannot vouch for its rows.

stories.title: A section without its closing, and one with two openings
A repeated record ID, a late opening date, an unknown kind
Yen: a fraction, and a cell past the columns
stories.recipe: Yen has no decimals; 1500.5 is refused, not rounded.

stories.title: A TB row typed Account with a capital
stories.recipe: Account and account are two words; a row of unknown type could be a total over any.

stories.title: A section whose columns say Amount
Sixty accounts across three TB pages
stories.recipe: Two accounts that differ, one inconsistent, one absent from the TB.
